purpose: Canonical browse entry point for China Grade 1-6 and mathematical-topic navigation.

sequence: Resolve selected grade to China learning stage.
Filter concepts using curriculum placement status.
Separate verified current PEP placement, stage-relevant content and cross-cutting practices.
Show selected China grade/stage relevance as a status.
Keep concepts visible even when they are outside the selected stage only in an explicit related-content view.

display_contract.china_locator: Verified current PEP locator if available; otherwise learning stage + curriculum section.
display_contract.comparison_availability: England and Common Core comparison routes when available.
display_contract.evidence_status: Visible qualification label when source status is partial/pending.
display_contract.search_terms: Optional teacher-friendly aliases; never displayed as curriculum labels unless they are canonical terminology.

runtime_rules: Browse and search both resolve the same concept_id.
Opening a concept from browse uses mathbridge_runtime_manifest.json for comparison/diagnostic/task/evidence assembly.
China grade selection does not alter neutral concept identity.
England/Common Core grade placement is not used to decide China browse eligibility.
Current PEP sequence remains an overlay, not a fallback from legacy textbooks.
